title: snapshot() and readOnlySnapshot() of a read-only TrieMap snapshot throw NullPointerException
oracle: immutable.TreeMap model of each map and snapshot; any public read on a read-only snapshot must answer
generator: wave4/harness/library/Maps.scala TrieMapFam: snapshot ops applied to any live target, including earlier read-only snapshots
detail: readOnlySnapshot() returns a TrieMap whose rootupdater is null. Calling readOnlySnapshot() or snapshot() on that map runs RDCSS_ROOT, which calls CAS_ROOT through the null updater and throws NullPointerException (TrieMap.scala:729 via 769, 857). The rest of the read API works on the read-only map, because iterator, size, keySet and view test nonReadOnly first; the two snapshot methods do not. The static type of readOnlySnapshot() is collection.Map, so callers reach this only after a cast or through code that receives a TrieMap that happens to be read-only, for example a snapshot passed to a method that takes a TrieMap and snapshots its argument. Likelihood in ordinary code is low; the failure is an unexplained NPE rather than an UnsupportedOperationException.
fix_sketch: In readOnlySnapshot, return this when !nonReadOnly (a read-only snapshot never changes); in snapshot, build a new writable TrieMap over r.copyToGen(new Gen, this) without the RDCSS when !nonReadOnly. No binary compatibility cost.
prior: none found (wave-three TrieMap findings KT1 to KT6, FW4, M9 are other causes; retronym/scala PR 677 guards its new clone path with nonReadOnly, so it does not hit this)
